scope: Fresh live frontier after Batch 485; four verified unaudited mechanics records were enriched.

selected.name: Final Flash (Super)
selected.finding: Current dedicated skill evidence confirms 200-Ki Ki Blast Super, SSGSS Vegeta (Evolved) character use, CaC unavailability, 24-hit beam sequence and about 30% source-reported damage.
selected.change: Canonical mechanics expanded with complete current sequence and availability boundary.

selected.name: God Splitter
selected.finding: Current evidence describes the 100-Ki Zamasu-training Super as a defensive energy sphere that blocks Ki Blasts, damages contact, can be launched with additional input, or dispersed by guarding.
selected.change: Canonical mechanics expanded to cover defensive and offensive modes.

selected.name: Majin Kamehameha
selected.finding: Current evidence confirms 100-Ki PQ60 Super, Majin CaC restriction, three charge stages, and about 10%/5-hit base versus 15%/15-hit maximum source-reported output.
selected.change: Canonical mechanics expanded with charge/output detail and restriction.

selected.name: Feint Crash
selected.finding: Current evidence confirms 100-Ki Cooler-training Strike Super, restanding teleport-punch default, and alternate second-input teleport-kick knockback behavior.
selected.change: Canonical mechanics expanded with both input branches and their distinct follow-up properties.

sources_policy: Current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence prioritized; source-reported numerical values remain bounded and unsupported frame/probability claims are not inferred.
canonical_sync: Four records synchronized in docs/data/skills.json and docs/data/skills-index.json.
